definitions.explanation: The upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}もも⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
スクワット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{太|ふと}もも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
examples.english: I train my thighs with squats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}ったら→登る：00660_noboru⟧{太|ふと}もも⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}→筋肉痛：06298_kinnikutsuu⟧になった。
examples.english: My thighs were sore after climbing a long staircase.

notes:
{太|ふと}もも refers to the thigh — the upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee. The word combines ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧ (thick/fat) with もも (thigh), literally "thick thigh."

WRITING:
Also written as {太腿|ふともも} in full kanji. The hiragana-mix spelling {太|ふと}もも is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}もも⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my thighs hurt
- {太|ふと}もも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train/strengthen one's thighs
- {太|ふと}もも⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}→筋肉痛：06298_kinnikutsuu⟧: thigh muscle soreness
- {太|ふと}もも⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: back of the thigh (hamstring area)
